suggestion:
Minimal integration plan for the horror and audio side of the Home layer, grounded in the citations above:

1. Fix the dread unit mismatch first. Make the horror director emit the same 0..1 fraction that run.ts:1381 and the story thresholds (story/index.ts:118-121) expect, e.g. value / 100 at director.ts:115. Decide one source of truth for run.dreadPts (run.ts:775) and the HorrorDirector meter (dread.ts:72), and feed phone-deal dread into HorrorState (session.ts:248-266). Without this, the new scares and stingers will misfire.

2. Reuse the horror pattern, not the casino world. Give the Home its own HorrorDirector-like tick (or a HomeDirector using dread.ts, observe.ts and the tickPatrons unseen-timer at director.ts:301-326). Point lights() at the apartment WorldLights (world/types.ts:86-97) and viewers() at the apartment camera.
